newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says member firms Q1 profits are $1.97 bln.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says member firms Q1 profits are $1.97 bln.

text.p: New York Stock Exchange said Thursday that member firms which do business with the public reported an aftertax profit of $1.97 billion on record revenues of $33.3 billion in the first quarter of 1997.
The Exchange said that that compared with a profit of $2.07 billion on revenues of $29.5 billion in the year-earlier period.

New York Stock Exchange specialists reported aftertax profits of $58 million on revenues of $225 million, said the exchange, versus record profits and revenues of $68 million and $231 million, respectively, in the first quarter of 1996.
Of the 306 firms dealing with the public, said the Exchange, 56 failed to turn a profit, while a year ago, 37 out of 310 such firms were in the red.
